note: An example project for development: import it with `pnpm admin project import deploy/examples/projects/*.json`, which creates the project and publishes it. Researchers edit projects in the studio. participants.mode is anonymous, optional or required; participants.pattern (a regular expression the whole id must match, such as W-[0-9]{4}; no quantified groups, at most two * or +, 100 characters) is optional and never sent to participants. uploads lists the platforms; each starts from a bundled platform pack (pack), or carries the project's own tree (structure and importer, as the studio saves them).
